title: Refresh clean idle worktrees without rewriting or discarding work
description: Schedule safe canonical convergence for idle unguarded worktrees. Merge, never rebase; skip active assignments/checks/resources, unsaved/staged work, uncommitted generated files, unknown providers and in-progress Git operations. Flag conflicts rather than forcing. Scratch cleanup must be manifest-owned and verified recoverable.
acceptanceCriteria: Clean unguarded idle branches converge by merge and unique commits remain reachable
Every active/dirty/guarded worktree is skipped with a precise reason; conflicts are preserved for its owner
No force push; reset; arbitrary scratch deletion; or silent stash is used
